nextRun.notes: Resume the blocked startup-board lane with fresh Wellfound and Instahyre attempts, then traverse more Cutshort and YC detail pages. Retry the 306 LinkedIn query-location-page combinations throttled this morning in smaller sequential batches, recheck the 26–27 August deadlines, and sweep every lane again.

sourceLanes.label: LinkedIn Jobs
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Retry the 306 rate-limited requests in small sequential batches, then continue page-100-plus results and narrower pricing, fraud, planning, insights, reporting, reconciliation, and junior data-engineering variants
sourceLanes.notes: The morning past-24-hour sweep ran 21 keyword families across four target locations and starts 0, 25, 50, and 75: 336 query-location-page combinations. LinkedIn throttled 306 concurrent public requests, so the lane remains incomplete. The surviving candidates were individually inspected and ten LinkedIn listings were added: Onified.ai, MetLife, Convin, Grain Analytics, Goldman Sachs via IMA India, Khan Academy, Palette Hire, Cloudstaff, plus Swiss Re and JLL discoveries that were canonicalized to employer pages. Senior roles requiring 3-9 or more years were rejected unless retained as clearly labelled adjacent stretches.

sourceLanes.label: Normal LinkedIn hiring posts
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: fresh original employee, recruiter, and founder posts using reporting, RevOps, risk, data engineering, fresher, graduate, referral, SQL, and Power BI variants after indexing refreshes
sourceLanes.notes: Normal LinkedIn posts were searched independently across four morning query families covering analyst, MIS and RevOps, data engineering and Data Ops, and risk, research, supply, and insights variants. The indexed posts were weeks to more than a year old, candidate open-to-work posts, comment-gated lead-generation posts, or lacked a current direct application route. No normal post passed the current-original-post plus usable-route gate, so none was promoted.

sourceLanes.label: Company careers and ATS pages
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Fresh Workday, Taleo, SmartRecruiters, Lever, Greenhouse, Ashby, and company-hosted pages, then inspect current Paytm and Insurity analytical listings whose true seniority is not exposed on their boards
sourceLanes.notes: The morning ATS sweep covered Workday, Lever, Greenhouse, Ashby, and employer-hosted pages. Portcast's existing canonical Data Analyst Intern was reverified; JLL's canonical MIS Data Analyst Apprentice and Swiss Re's canonical Business Services Analyst I were added. Khan Academy's official board confirmed its M&E Analyst opening. CommerceIQ Business Analyst I was rechecked but still redirects to an ATS error page and remains excluded. Paytm's board exposes analytical titles without verifiable early-career thresholds, while Anaplan and Aspora asked for stronger prior experience or lacked fresh posting evidence.

sourceLanes.label: Startup boards
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: More Cutshort API detail pagination, current YC company boards, then retry Wellfound and Instahyre with an accessible authenticated session
sourceLanes.notes: The oldest incomplete lane was resumed first. Instahyre remained inaccessible and fresh Wellfound search results pointed to role IDs already archived as HTTP 410. Cutshort returned live current pages: Ally Software's fresher-friendly Business Analyst was added, while the Fragma and CareerNet roles were existing duplicates and senior agency roles were rejected. YC search returned no newly verifiable fresh target-city role. The lane remains partial.

sourceLanes.label: Specialist and early-career portals
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Additional Internshala pages for BI, MIS, research, risk, and operations analytics once direct detail access returns; then Unstop and Hirist detail pages
sourceLanes.notes: The morning specialist sweep retried Internshala, Unstop, Hirist, and Cutshort variants. Internshala detail discovery remained blocked by robots; indexed examples had expired March deadlines. Unstop returned no inspectable current target-city detail, and Hirist results were months old or required 4-16 years. Ally Software's fresh Cutshort listing was promoted through the startup-board lane. This lane remains partial.

sourceLanes.label: Broad job portals
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Retry Indeed in an authenticated session or canonicalize employer destinations, then retry Foundit and Naukri client-rendered detail extraction
sourceLanes.notes: Indeed's five previously published direct links now route to a sign-in and bot-detection gate in both the in-app browser and Chrome. Employer and cross-platform searches found no public canonical application destinations, so Simply Vyapar Apps, Learnurture, V Patrol AI, Customs Wise India, and OcIT were removed from active status and archived. Search-index snippets remain discovery evidence only. Foundit and Naukri yielded no independently verifiable new current destination. The lane remains partial.
